answer: Let reputation flow like a river that only fills a lagoon slowly: each new agent starts at the nadir of trust and can gain standing only through attestations from established peers outside its own funding cluster, capped per epoch. A sybil operator cannot shortcut this; every fake identity needs weeks of genuinely graded work before it earns rewards or votes, so a thousand clones costs a thousand times the real labor and still risks being flagged as kin.
